items.title: Kirill Kaprizov nets 10th goal in 9 games, pacing Wild past Jackets
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kirill Kaprizov joined elite company Sunday with his goal that helped the Minnesota Wild edge the Columbus Blue Jackets 2-1 in St. Paul, Minn.
items.body:
Kirill Kaprizov joined elite company Sunday with his goal that helped the Minnesota Wild edge the Columbus Blue Jackets 2-1 in St. Paul, Minn.
Kaprizov continued to live up to his eight-year, $136 million contract by scoring a power-play goal in the second period that broke a 1-1 tie. The Russian winger has scored at least one goal in three straight games and has points in six straight.
He also leads the league with 10 goals and joined Auston Matthews, Alex Ovechkin, David Pastrnak, Nikita Kucherov and Sidney Crosby as the only active players to hit the 10-goal mark in nine or fewer games.
Danila Yurov notched his fourth goal for the Wild, who have won four of their last five. Yakov Trenin, Maxim Shabanov and Joel Eriksson Ek added assists in the victory.
Jesper Wallstedt had to stop only 13 shots to record his fourth straight win.
Adam Fantilli scored his second goal of the season for Columbus, with Zach Werenski and Sean Monahan assisting.
Cam Talbot made 32 saves. He was tested early as Minnesota put eight shots on him in the first 7:08. He stopped them all. That included three during a 5-on-3 that lasted for 1:52 in the first four minutes.
Still, the Wild managed to score first when Trenin captured a loose puck in the neutral zone, leading to a 2-on-1. Yurov beat Talbot after collecting a Trenin crossing pass with 1:48 remaining in the opening period.
That lead just lasted a minute as the Blue Jackets took advantage of a delayed penalty. Fantilli came on as the extra attacker and scored from just beyond the right faceoff circle.
Minnesota entered Sunday with the league's second-best power-play unit at 33.3% (8-for-24). The Wild went 1-for-4, with Kaprizov scoring his third of the season on the man advantage with 16:54 left in the second, beating Talbot on the short side from the right circle.
The Blue Jackets, playing their second game in less than 24 hours, were held to a season-low 14 shots.
Minnesota, which has won its first four home games for the first time since 2016, limited Columbus to just seven shots in the last two periods.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Canada-Un feu de prairie sur une base militaire en Alberta tue 4 personnes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Un incendie déclenché par un feu de broussailles a tué quatre soldats et fait 39 blessés, dont 19 se trouvent dans un état critique, sur une base d'entraînement de l'armée canadienne dans la province de l'Alberta, dans l'ouest du pays, ont déclaré dimanche soir les autorités locales.
items.body:
Un incendie déclenché par un feu de broussailles a tué quatre soldats et fait 39 blessés, dont 19 se trouvent dans un état critique, sur une base d'entraînement de l'armée canadienne dans la province de l'Alberta, dans l'ouest du pays, ont déclaré dimanche soir les autorités locales.
Le Premier ministre canadien Mark Carney a décrit l'incident survenu sur la base de Wainwright comme l'une des pires tragédies pour l'armée canadienne en temps de paix sur le territoire national.
Des vents allant jusqu'à 96 km/h ont propagé le feu, qui s'était déclenché samedi aux alentours de 16h00 (22h00 GMT).
Au cours d'une conférence de presse, un commandant de l'armée a souligné à quel point les flammes avaient progressé à un rythme "hors du commun".
"Je n'avais jamais vu quelque chose comme cela", a dit le général Wade Rutland devant les journalistes.
La Première ministre de l'Alberta, Danielle Smith, a déclaré que la plupart des blessés auront besoin de soins spécifiques et intensifs pendant "des semaines et des mois".
Quand l'incendie s'est déclenché, a rapporté Wade Rutland, 85 soldats effectuaient un entraînement au combat à "haute intensité" sur la base de Wainwright, située dans une prairie.
Ces soldats se préparaient à un déploiement en Lettonie, où l'armée canadienne effectue actuellement sa principale opération à l'étranger, a-t-il précisé.
Une enquête a été ouverte pour déterminer ce qui a causé le feu de broussailles. Wade Rutland a dit ne pas vouloir spéculer sur l'origine de l'incendie, tout en ajoutant ne pas penser qu'il y avait eu une "interférence externe".

items.title: イタリアでも生活費巡るデモ、一部暴徒化し警察と衝突　多数拘束
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ミラノ １８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ミラノ １８日 ロイター] - イタリアのミラノで１８日、公共サービスの低下や生活費高騰に抗議するデモ隊の一部が暴徒化して投石や店舗での略奪を行い、警察と衝突した。隣国フランスでも大規模な抗議活動が行われ、数千人が逮捕されている。

関係者がロイターに語ったところによると、中心部のドゥオーモ広場周辺でフードをかぶった数百人の抗議者が店舗の窓を割ったりゴミ箱に火をつけた。これを受け警官隊が催涙ガスを発射し放水車を使用した。６０人以上の抗議者が詳しい身元確認などのため警察署に連行されたという。

１７日にもミラノのほか、ボローニャ、ブレシア、ベルガモ、トリノなどの北部都市で同様の衝突が発生し、計２８人の抗議者が逮捕された。

２０２７年に選挙を控えるメローニ首相は暴力を非難し、１９日に政府で対応を協議すると述べた。

items.title: Asian stocks slip, Wall St and bonds benefit from oil skid
items.author: Wayne Cole
items.creator: Wayne Cole
items.summary: Asian share markets slipped on Monday as unease over AI's enormous funding needs undermined confidence ahead of a week packed with earnings, while Chinese economic data pipped forecasts in a positive for world growth.
items.body:
Asian share markets slipped on Monday as unease over AI's enormous funding needs undermined confidence ahead of a week packed with [USN:L6N462161 TEXT:"earnings"], while Chinese economic data pipped forecasts in a positive for world growth.
A fall in oil prices offered some support to bonds and Wall Street stock futures, limiting Asia's losses. Oil fell following US President [USN:L6N464042 TEXT:"Donald Trump's"] decision to waive some sanctions on Russia, though he later said a final decision on the matter had not been made.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that the president would take up to 60 days to assess the economic impact of such a move. Brent futures still fell 1.7% to $107.95 a barrel, while US crude futures lost 0.8% to $100.62 a barrel.
Meanwhile, Iran reported another [USN:S8N44Y01I TEXT:"tanker"] had hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
Geopolitical tensions combined with safe-haven flows from equities to extend a rally in sovereign bonds, with 10-year Treasury yields down 4 basis points at 5.0525% , having just recorded their largest weekly fall in over eight months.
All of this helped S&P 500 futures edge up 0.7%, while Nasdaq futures rose 1.0%.
Asian markets were hampered by concerns about tech and Japan's Nikkei (.N225) fell 1.2%, after losing 5.4% last week. South Korea (.KS11) dropped 0.4%, having shed more than 14% last week, while Taiwan (.TWII) fell 1.4%.
MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) eased 0.6%.
"Investors have long worried that AI revenues won't be sufficient to recoup the massive upfront investment, while AI infrastructure may need to be written down as it ages and depreciates in the meantime, which lowers book value massively," said My Bui, an economist at fund manager AMP.
"Rising government bond yields and wider corporate credit spreads are increasing financing costs, making it harder to borrow, refinance, and keep the AI infrastructure build-out going."
Chinese blue chips (.CSI300) dipped 0.2%, but pared early losses after data showed the economy grew 4.5% in the third quarter to just pip forecasts. Retail sales were also better with a rise of 1.1%, while industrial output growth came in on forecasts at 5.5%.
China's yuan also firmed to its strongest level since July 2022 at 6.6828 .
A LOT RIDING ON EARNINGS The PHLX Semiconductor Index shed 11.4% (.SOX) last week in its longest losing streak since 2008.
Investors will be hoping Meta (META.O) will beat Wall Street forecasts when it reports earnings on Wednesday, along with semiconductor firms Lam Research (LRCX.O) and Texas Instruments (TXN.O) and Elon Musk-led companies SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) .
Meta is one of five AI hyperscalers that combined are expected to increase their capital spending to about $1.2 trillion next year, according to Goldman Sachs.
Others reporting include Netflix (NFLX.O) , Procter & Gamble (PG.N) , General Motors (GM.N) and GE Aerospace (GE.N) .
Earnings are still expected to rise 30% overall thanks to the huge profits made by tech firms.
European stocks were weighed down by political uncertainty in [USN:L1N46401W TEXT:"France"] with EUROSTOXX 50 futures off 0.3%, while DAX futures lost 0.2% and FTSE futures eased 0.1%.
Those same concerns saw the euro ease 0.1% to $1.1232 , nearer to last week's 16-month low of $1.1113.
The dollar dipped 0.1% against the yen to 157.89 and has spent the entire month so far in a tight range as the threat of Japanese intervention has kept speculative sellers at bay.
In commodity markets, non-interest-bearing gold got a lift from falling yields and rose 0.4% to $4,181 an ounce .

SYDNEY: Asian share markets slipped on Monday (Oct 19) as unease over AI's enormous funding needs undermined confidence ahead of a week packed with earnings, while Chinese economic data pipped forecasts in a positive for world growth.
A fall in oil prices offered some support to bonds and Wall Street stock futures, limiting Asia's losses. Oil fell following US President Donald Trump's decision to waive some sanctions on Russia, though he later said a final decision on the matter had not been made.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that the president would take up to 60 days to assess the economic impact of such a move. Brent futures still fell 1.7 per cent to US$107.95 a barrel, while US crude futures lost 0.8 per cent to US$100.62 a barrel.
Meanwhile, Iran reported another tanker had hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

Geopolitical tensions combined with safe-haven flows from equities to extend a rally in sovereign bonds, with 10-year Treasury yields down 4 basis points at 5.0525 per cent, having just recorded their largest weekly fall in over eight months.
All of this helped S&P 500 futures edge up 0.7 per cent, while Nasdaq futures rose 1.0 per cent.
Asian markets were hampered by concerns about tech and Japan's Nikkei fell 1.2 per cent, after losing 5.4 per cent last week. South Korea dropped 0.4 per cent, having shed more than 14 per cent last week, while Taiwan fell 1.4 per cent.
MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan eased 0.6 per cent.
"Investors have long worried that AI revenues won't be sufficient to recoup the massive upfront investment, while AI infrastructure may need to be written down as it ages and depreciates in the meantime, which lowers book value massively," said My Bui, an economist at fund manager AMP.
"Rising government bond yields and wider corporate credit spreads are increasing financing costs, making it harder to borrow, refinance, and keep the AI infrastructure build-out going."
Chinese blue chips dipped 0.2 per cent, but pared early losses after data showed the economy grew 4.5 per cent in the third quarter to just pip forecasts. Retail sales were also better with a rise of 1.1 per cent, while industrial output growth came in on forecasts at 5.5 per cent.
China's yuan also firmed to its strongest level since July 2022 at 6.6828.

Related:

China's economic growth accelerates to 4.5% in third quarter

Indonesian stocks slide to six-year low as MSCI warning weighs

A LOT RIDING ON EARNINGS The PHLX Semiconductor Index shed 11.4 per cent last week in its longest losing streak since 2008.
Investors will be hoping Meta will beat Wall Street forecasts when it reports earnings on Wednesday, along with semiconductor firms Lam Research and Texas Instruments and Elon Musk-led companies SpaceX and Tesla .
Meta is one of five AI hyperscalers that combined are expected to increase their capital spending to about US$1.2 trillion next year, according to Goldman Sachs.
Others reporting include Netflix, Procter & Gamble , General Motors and GE Aerospace.
Earnings are still expected to rise 30 per cent overall thanks to the huge profits made by tech firms.
European stocks were weighed down by political uncertainty in France with EUROSTOXX 50 futures off 0.3 per cent, while DAX futures lost 0.2 per cent and FTSE futures eased 0.1 per cent.
Those same concerns saw the euro ease 0.1 per cent to US$1.1232, nearer to last week's 16-month low of US$1.1113.
The dollar dipped 0.1 per cent against the yen to 157.89 and has spent the entire month so far in a tight range as the threat of Japanese intervention has kept speculative sellers at bay.
In commodity markets, non-interest-bearing gold got a lift from falling yields and rose 0.4 per cent to US$4,181 an ounce.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: サッカー＝フライブルク、今季初黒星で首位陥落　後藤は先発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［レーバークーゼン（ドイツ）　１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［レーバークーゼン（ドイツ）　１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１８日、各地で試合を行い、フライブルクが敵地でレーバークーゼンに１─２で逆転負けし、今季初黒星を喫した。

後藤啓介が先発したフライブルクは前半１４分に先制。しかし、同１９分に追いつかれると、後半３１分にパトリック・シックに逆転弾を許した。シックはレーバークーゼンの選手として初めてリーグ開幕から６試合連続ゴールを挙げた選手となった。

後藤は後半１９分までプレー。チームメートの山本理仁はベンチから出番がなく、前節退場した鈴木唯人は出場停止でメンバー外だった。フライブルクは首位から陥落し、３位に後退した。

ホッフェンハイムの町田浩樹は敵地でのボルシアＭＧ戦でフル出場し、２─１の勝利に貢献した。ボルシアＭＧの宇野禅斗は先発し、後半３４分までプレー。チームメートの町野修斗は同６分から、橋岡大樹は同１５分から途中出場、板倉滉はメンバー外だった。ボルシアＭＧは開幕６連敗。

items.title: Indonesian stocks slide to six-year low as MSCI warning weighs
items.author: Ankur Banerjee
items.creator: Ankur Banerjee
items.summary: Indonesian stocks slid to a six-year low on Monday as a warning from MSCI over possible expulsion from its global indexes next year rattled fragile investor sentiment, sharpening the focus on how Jakarta intends to allay the index provider's concerns.
items.body:
Indonesian stocks slid to a six-year low on Monday as a warning from MSCI over possible expulsion from its global indexes next year rattled fragile [USN:L1N4620AO TEXT:"investor sentiment"], sharpening the focus on how Jakarta intends to allay the index provider's concerns.
Jakarta's benchmark stocks (.JKSE) fell over 5% in early trading on Monday after plunging 11.6% on Friday, as the world's [USN:L6N42G0I9 TEXT:"worst performers"] reeled from index provider MSCI saying it was [USN:L4N46124S TEXT:"considering"] shifting Indonesia to [USN:L6N46208E TEXT:""standalone" status"] from its current "emerging markets" mantle.
A shift to standalone status would risk cutting [USN:L6N46202Y TEXT:"Southeast Asia's biggest economy"] off from international capital, relegate it to an investment backwater and club it with a group of standalone markets that includes Lebanon and Zimbabwe.
The more-severe-than-expected move has raised the stakes for Indonesia's regulators and finance officials.
On Monday, the Indonesia Stock Exchange (JKmad.JK) said it cut its lower auto-rejection limit to 7% from 15% to give investors "an opportunity to evaluate and digest available information, helping them make better investment decisions based on Indonesia's economic fundamentals".
The move followed a weekend meeting between the financial regulator and capital market participants, including analysts and economists.
An Indonesian regulator on Friday also unveiled sanctions against those linked to alleged trading manipulation in shares of three firms, with the fines totalling 2.1 trillion rupiah ($116.4 million).
Angus Mackintosh, an ASEAN specialist at Aletheia Capital in Singapore, said the fact the fines were announced on Friday suggests that Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) has been working on the matter for a while.
"The fines are a positive move, but there needs to be concerted action to stamp the authority of the OJK and take direct action against certain well-known players who have been involved in market abuse," he said.
MSCI had threatened a [USN:L1N3YU05Z TEXT:"downgrade"] to "frontier" status in January because of [USN:L1N3YY0EJ TEXT:"opacity in ownership"] and trading behaviour but said on Friday the lack of progress in remedying those concerns meant even a drop to that status would not reflect the severity of the issues.
"The burden of proof has shifted: avoiding reclassification will require clear evidence that the announced reforms have been consistently implemented and materially improved market functioning," strategists at Goldman Sachs said in a note.
WIDER RISKS FROM MSCI'S WARNING Goldman Sachs estimates a full MSCI removal could trigger $5.6 billion of passive outflows. Active funds benchmarked to these indexes hold more than $8 billion, although any selling would be discretionary rather than benchmark-driven, they wrote.
Foreign investors have net sold $4.88 billion worth of Indonesian stocks so far this year, on track for the biggest annual outflow in at least 16 years.
Aninda Mitra, head of Asia macro and investment strategy at BNY Investments, said foreign equity exposure to Indonesia has shrunk to the point where "there may not be much more downside from here."
"But at the same time, even if there are some interesting and fundamentally sound companies and banks, attracting sufficiently large amounts of capital will be tougher in this environment," he said.
MSCI's warning raises the stakes for the government of President Prabowo Subianto, which has faced a series of setbacks this year, with Moody's and Fitch having cut their sovereign rating outlooks to negative earlier in 2026.
Investors are also fretting over the ramifications beyond the $500 billion stock market, with the rupiah weakening to 18,040 per dollar, not far from the record low of 18,190 hit in June.
"Our bigger concern is not index-related selling itself," said Gary Tan, portfolio manager at Allspring Global Investments in Singapore, "but the potential near-term spillover into the rupiah and domestic bond yields, where market dislocation could translate into tighter financial conditions and a more meaningful impact on the real economy."
($1 = 18,040.0000 rupiah)

items.title: 豪労働需給、予想より速い緩和の兆し＝中銀総裁補
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [シドニー １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[シドニー １９日 ロイター] - オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）のケント総裁補は１９日、労働市場が予想より速いペースで緩んでいる兆候があると指摘した。ただ、１カ月分のデータを過度に重視しないよう注意を促した。

豪中銀の金融市場部門を率いるケント氏は銀行関連の会議で、先週発表された統計で９月の失業率が予想外に５年ぶり高水準の４．７％に上昇したことを受け、市場が追加利上げの確率を引き下げたと指摘し、こうした動きは理にかなっていると述べた。

「月次の数字については常にやや慎重に見ている」と説明。その上で、政策当局者が直面する重要な問題は、労働市場の緩みが需要の減退によるものか、それとも人件費の急上昇によるものかという点だとし、来週発表予定の四半期インフレデータがこの疑問の解明に役立つだろうと語った。

「それでもなお、労働市場の需給逼迫度合いが、われわれの予想よりやや速く緩んでいることを示す指標がある」と話した。

労働市場の堅調さは、豪中銀がインフレ対策として今年４回の利上げを行った理由の一つだが、基調インフレ率は３カ月連続で３．６％に固着しており、リスクは依然として上向きに傾いている。

市場は１１月２─３日に開催される次回の政策決定会合で利上げが行われる確率を３０％と織り込んでいるが、１２月までの利上げについては約５０％と織り込まれている。

items.title: サッカー＝リヨン首位も中村が一発退場、南野先発モナコは敗戦
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部は１８日、各地で試合を行い、中村敬斗が所属するリヨンはホームでニースに２─１で逆転勝ちし、首位に浮上した。中村は後半１６分から途中出場したが、同２５分に一発退場となった。

リヨンは前半１８分に先制を許したものの、同３２分にパベル・シュルツ、同３６分にタナー・テスマンが得点して逆転した。

中村は後半２５分、浮き球を処理しようと高く上げた右足が相手選手の腹部付近に当たり、危険なプレーとしてレッドカードを提示された。リヨンは残り約２０分を１０人で戦い、後半追加タイム４分にはネットを揺らされたが、オフサイドの判定で得点は認められず、逃げ切った。

リヨンは７試合を終えて勝ち点１４とし、パリ・サンジェルマン、パリＦＣ、リール、モナコと並んだが、得失点差で首位に立った。

南野拓実が所属するモナコは敵地でロリアンに０─１で敗れ、今季リーグ戦初黒星を喫した。先発出場した南野は後半７分に退いた。

Oct 18 (Reuters) – An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv with 57 aboard made an emergency landing in the Bulgarian capital of Sofia after a “bomb threat signal”, Sky news said on Sunday, citing the country’s transport ministry.

Austrian Airlines and the ministry did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. Reuters could not immediately verify the report.

items.body:
フランスのマクロン大統領は18日、物価高や公共サービスの質低下に抗議する前日のデモが国内各地で暴動に発展したことを受け、国民に冷静な対応を呼びかけた。暴動は同国で近年最悪規模となり、商店が略奪や破壊の被害を受けた。

ヌニェス内相によると、17日にはデモ参加者1人が心停止で死亡した。全国で約2400人が逮捕され、警官約1000人が負傷した。

中部の都市リモージュでは17日、築140年の歴史ある市庁舎が放火され、大部分が焼失した。目撃者が撮影した映像には、屋根の一部が崩落する瞬間が映っている。

「まるで戦場のようだ」――オランダからパリを訪れていたという男性は、滞在先のホテルからの避難を余儀なくされたという。「友人を訪ねるためにパリに来た。宿泊先のホテルはレピュブリック広場にある。クルマも荷物も置いたまま、避難しなければならなかった。全て無事であることを願っている」

マクロン氏はテレビ放映された国民向け演説で「こうした映像を見て、われわれは皆、彼らは何を考えていたのか、フランス人がどうしてフランスにこんなことをできるのかと自問した」と述べた。「何をもってしても正当化も説明も弁解もできない。今夜、われわれは皆、怒りと恥ずかしさを感じている」と語った。

17日の暴動は、マクロン氏に対する根深い怒りを浮き彫りにした。2027年までの10年に及ぶ在任期間は、社会の不満の高まりや経済低迷、債務の膨張が目立つものとなっている。

マクロン氏は、平和的に抗議していた人々の不満には正当な理由があるとし、混乱を引き起こそうとする人々の行動と混同すべきではないと述べた。

「私たちの社会は本当に病んでいる。どこへ向かっているのか分からない」――暴動から一夜明けたパリ市内で、ある女性はこのように語った。「彼らは国を大混乱に陥れ、何もかも破壊しようとしたのだと思う。民主主義も、市庁舎のような美しい建物も、全てを」

items.title: テルアビブ発オーストリア航空機、爆弾予告でブルガリアに緊急着陸
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１８日 ロイター] - イスラエルのテルアビブ発、ウイーン行きのオーストリア航空のエアバスＡ３２０機（乗員乗客５７人）が１８日、「爆弾予告」の通報を受け、ブルガリアの首都ソフィアに緊急着陸した。スカイニュースが同国運輸省の情報として伝えた。

オーストリア運輸省は声明で「飛行中、ルーマニア国境付近で乗務員が爆弾予告を通報し、ソフィアに緊急着陸することを決めた」と明らかにした。同国空軍戦闘機がソフィアに着陸するまで同機を護衛し、着陸後に乗客が機外へ避難したとした。

航空機追跡サイト「フライトレーダー２４」のデータによると、同機は午後９時過ぎにルーマニア領空に入り、その後、進路を南に取りブルガリアに向かった。

items.title: 原油先物は下落、米の制裁免除でロシア燃料供給増の観測
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Florence Tan

[シンガポール １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Florence Tan

[シンガポール １９日 ロイター] - アジア時間の原油先物は下落している。トランプ米大統領がロシアに対する制裁と関税の適用を免除したことで、ロシア産燃料の輸出が増加する可能性があることが背景。

１８日２３４０ＧＭＴ（日本時間１９日午前８時４０分）時点で、北海ブレント先物は１．４３ドル（１．３０％）安の１バレル＝１０８．４３ドル。前週末１６日は清算値で５月１９日以来の高値を付けていた。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．５３ドル（０．５２％）安の１００．８８ドル。

トランプ氏は１６日、「グラム法」に基づく主要な制裁と関税の適用を免除する大統領令に署名した。同法は、ウクライナで戦争を続けるロシアへの圧力強化を求める議員らの働きかけを受け、トランプ氏が９月に署名して成立した。

ただ、ルビオ米国務長官によると、トランプ氏は最大６０日をかけて適用免除の経済的影響を評価する。

今回の措置に先立ち、トランプ氏はロシアのプーチン大統領と、ロシア産ディーゼル燃料を米国に輸出することで合意した。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、こうした米国の行動はウクライナに打撃を与えると述べた。

北海ブレント先物は１６日に一時、５月以来初めて１１０ドルに達した。中東の緊張や安全保障上の脅威により、船舶航行の安全や世界のエネルギー供給逼迫への懸念が高まった。

items.title: Drew Rasmussen pitches Rays to 3-2 ALCS series lead over Guardians
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: CLEVELAND -- The Tampa Bay Rays are one win away from the World Series, and they'll have two chances to clinch a berth at home.
items.body:
CLEVELAND -- The Tampa Bay Rays are one win away from the World Series, and they'll have two chances to clinch a berth at home.
Yandy Diaz had three hits and scored a run, and Drew Rasmussen carried a shutout into the sixth inning as the Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-1 in Game 5 of the American League Championship Series on Sunday.
The teams had alternated wins through the first four games before Tampa Bay claimed its second straight victory in Cleveland to take a 3-2 series lead.
The Rays are seeking their third AL pennant and their first World Series title.
"Momentum is big in this sport. We have it, and we're going to keep it," said Tampa Bay outfielder Jonny DeLuca, who opened the scoring with a bases-loaded walk in the first inning. "Once bats get hot, they say it's contagious and it's true. It carried over from (Saturday)."
Game 6 is Monday in St. Petersburg, Fla., where Game 7 would also be played Tuesday if necessary. The National League champion Milwaukee Brewers await the ALCS winner in the World Series.
The Rays have won 58 of their 85 regular-season and postseason games at home, but doubts remained about their ability to thrive outside their domed stadium.
Two victories in three games in Cleveland -- following a road win in their AL Division Series finale against the New York Yankees -- have bolstered their confidence.
"This is a tough place to win, so it was a fun couple of days to get them," Tampa Bay closer Bryan Baker said. "We've played pretty good at (Tropicana Field), but we knew we had to win a couple on the road, as well, in the playoffs. We're doing that now."
Rasmussen (2-0) pitched seven innings, allowing one run on four hits to earn his second win of the postseason. The right-hander struck out six and walked one, lowering his ERA in three postseason starts this fall to 1.29.
Cam Booser and Tyler Wells worked the eighth inning, and Baker pitched the ninth for his fifth save in as many postseason opportunities. The Rays combined to limit Cleveland to five hits.
Jo Adell, Nathaniel Lowe and Travis Bazzana came to the plate as potential tying runs against Baker, who walked Chase DeLauter to begin the ninth, but all three were retired.
"This team is built on trust and being able to rely on the guys," Wells said. "It makes your job a lot easier knowing that."
Tampa Bay scored once in each of the first three innings against Parker Messick (0-3) and Tim Herrin to take a 3-0 lead.
Messick walked DeLuca with the bases loaded to bring home Diaz in the first, and Jonathan Aranda's single scored Ben Williamson in the second. Liam Hicks added an RBI single off Herrin in the third to score Chandler Simpson.
Messick was pulled after a career-low two innings, allowing two runs on five hits and two walks. The left-hander struck out three and threw 57 pitches, his fewest in 43 major league starts.
"We didn't anticipate going to the bullpen in the third, but it didn't feel right to put Parker back out there," Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said. "Rasmussen was really good tonight. We fought and battled, but just couldn't get the big hit."
The Guardians cut their deficit to 3-1 in the sixth when Steven Kwan singled and scored on DeLauter's groundout. Cleveland's only hit through the first five innings was a two-out single by DeLauter in the first.
Simpson, Aranda and Hicks had two hits apiece for Tampa Bay. Taylor Walls was thrown out at home by left fielder Kwan in the fourth.
Kwan singled twice and made a leaping catch at the center-field wall in the ninth, taking away an extra-base hit from Victor Mesa Jr.
"We're doing the hard part of getting guys on base, getting in scoring position," Kwan said. "I feel like we were one hit away, but it just didn't come today."
Jose Ramirez reached base for the 17th consecutive postseason game, breaking Cleveland's franchise record. DeLauter tied the franchise record for hits by a rookie in a single postseason with 11.
--Brian Dulik, Field Level Media

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[１６日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手がける米コアウィーブのマイケル・イントレーター最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と同氏の関連事業体が、２０２５年３月の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）以降、１０億ドル近くの同社株を売却していたことが規制当局への提出資料で分かった。大半は事前に設定した取引計画に基づく売却だった。

売却は、株価が２５年６月に過去最高値を付けた約２カ月後に始まった。株価はその後急落し、１２日からの週は約２５％下落した。利上げ観測が強まる中、エヌビディアが出資する同社の巨額の設備投資と資金調達を巡る懸念が高まっている。

売却は、株価が２５年６月に過去最高値を付けた約２カ月後に始まった。株価はその後急落し、１２日からの週は約２５％下落した。利上げ観測が強まる中、エヌビディアが出資する同社の巨額の設備投資と資金調達を巡る懸念が高まっている。

コアウィーブはロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。

提出資料の詳細は以下の通り。

• 売却株数は計１０００万株超。１５日終値時点のコアウィーブの時価総額は３８４億４０００万ドルだった。

• 売却したのはイントレーター氏のほか、同氏が業務執行社員を務めるオムナドラ・キャピタルや２つの信託などの関連事業体。

• 約４０００万ドル分を除く大半の売却は、事前に設定した取引計画に基づいていた。こうした計画は、経営幹部があらかじめ決めた日程で株式を売却できるようにするもので、事業に対する経営陣の見方を必ずしも反映するわけではない。

• 取引計画に含まれていなかった約４０００万ドル分は、権利が確定した株式にかかる税金を支払うために市場で株式を売却する「セル・トゥ・カバー」だった。

• 売却が行われたのは、コアウィーブがＡＩ計算需要に対応するためデータセンター網を急速に拡大し、エヌビディア製半導体への支出を増やしつつ、受注残を１２９０億ドル超に積み上げている時期と重なった

• 同社は８月、年間設備投資額の見通しを３５０億─３９０億ドルに引き上げた。

売却は、株価が２５年６月に過去最高値を付けた約２カ月後に始まった。株価はその後急落し、１２日からの週は約２５％下落した。利上げ観測が強まる中、エヌビディアが出資する同社の巨額の設備投資と資金調達を巡る懸念が高まっている。

コアウィーブはロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。

提出資料の詳細は以下の通り。

• 売却株数は計１０００万株超。１５日終値時点のコアウィーブの時価総額は３８４億４０００万ドルだった。

• 売却したのはイントレーター氏のほか、同氏が業務執行社員を務めるオムナドラ・キャピタルや２つの信託などの関連事業体。

• 約４０００万ドル分を除く大半の売却は、事前に設定した取引計画に基づいていた。こうした計画は、経営幹部があらかじめ決めた日程で株式を売却できるようにするもので、事業に対する経営陣の見方を必ずしも反映するわけではない。

• 取引計画に含まれていなかった約４０００万ドル分は、権利が確定した株式にかかる税金を支払うために市場で株式を売却する「セル・トゥ・カバー」だった。

• 売却が行われたのは、コアウィーブがＡＩ計算需要に対応するためデータセンター網を急速に拡大し、エヌビディア製半導体への支出を増やしつつ、受注残を１２９０億ドル超に積み上げている時期と重なった

• 同社は８月、年間設備投資額の見通しを３５０億─３９０億ドルに引き上げた。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．７７％（５０４円７３銭）安の６万４８１９円５６銭と、反落してスタートした。前週末の米市場で、ＡＩ（人工知能）株への懸念が重しとなり、ハイテク株が下落した流れを引き継いだ。指数寄与度の大きい半導体関連株を中心に売りが出て、日経平均は寄り付いた後も下げ幅を拡大。足元では１．７％（１１００円）超安となっている。

セクター別では、銀行や非鉄金属、ガラス・土石製品などが軟調。鉱業、水産・農林、陸運などは底堅い。

個別では、東京エレクトロンが２％超安、アドバンテストが４％超安。キオクシアホールディングス、ソフトバンクグループが売り気配でスタート。トヨタ自動車、リクルートホールディングス、指数寄与度の大きいファーストリテイリングが小幅安で推移。

items.title: BOJ chief says underlying inflation 'quite close' to price goal
items.author: Leika Kihara
items.creator: Leika Kihara
items.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Monday underlying inflation is "quite close" to the central bank's 2% target with strong global AI demand adding to inflationary pressure from a tight job market.
items.body:
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Monday underlying inflation is "quite close" to the central bank's 2% target with strong global AI demand adding to inflationary pressure from a tight job market.
The remarks came ahead of the central bank's key policy meeting later this month, where it will release fresh quarterly growth and inflation forecasts which will be scrutinised by markets for clues on the next interest rate-hike timing.
"It is becoming more important to anchor underlying inflation around our 2% target," Ueda told parliament.
While rising raw material costs from the Middle East conflict were pushing up inflation, a tight job market and moderate economic recovery were also applying demand-driven price pressure, Ueda said.
"Very strong global AI demand is also boosting capital expenditure and exports, thereby pushing up prices for a wide range of goods," he said.
Ueda also said raising interest rates at an appropriate pace would help avoid spikes in bond yields.
"As underlying inflation approaches 2% and financial conditions remain accommodative, failing to adjust our policy rate appropriately could push up long-term interest rates by stoking market concern over an inflation overshoot," he said.
Japanese government bond (JGB) yields have risen on prospects of further BOJ rate hikes and concerns that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's big spending plans could worsen the country's already strained finances.
When asked by an opposition lawmaker about the impact of fiscal spending on inflation, Ueda said increased expenditure would push up price and wage growth by stimulating the economy.
But if increased fiscal spending boosts Japan's supply capacity, that in turn could help moderate inflation in the long run, he added.
The BOJ has a two-day policy meeting that concludes on October 30. Having just raised rates in September, many in the BOJ are cautious about delivering another hike this month and prefer to gauge more data on how past rate increases have affected financial conditions, [USN:L4N45S011 TEXT:"sources have told Reuters"].
Many market players expect the BOJ to keep interest rates steady at 1.25% but drop hints that leave open scope for a hike to 1.5% as early as December.

items.title: Penguins, Mammoth look to rebound from blowout losses
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Pittsburgh Penguins and Utah Mammoth will look to bounce back from one-sided losses when they meet Monday night in Salt Lake City.
items.body:
The Pittsburgh Penguins and Utah Mammoth will look to bounce back from one-sided losses when they meet Monday night in Salt Lake City.
The Penguins were routed 6-2 by the Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday night in Las Vegas, around the same time the Mammoth suffered an identical loss to the visiting Edmonton Oilers.
The defeat was Pittsburgh's third straight loss and its sixth in seven games (1-5-1) following a 2-0 start. Monday's game in Utah will conclude a four-game road trip for the Penguins, who have surrendered at least five goals in each of the first three games.
"We can't be feeling bad for ourselves. It's on all of us, myself included," Penguins coach Dan Muse said. "So, together as a group, we've got to dig in. We have to find consistency in our game. There's a lot coming off of (Saturday) night that we have to clean up from a structural standpoint."
The Golden Knights gave Pittsburgh a lesson in puck management, scoring three even-strength goals in the first period before Sidney Crosby scored a power-play goal at 5:54 of the second to cut the deficit to 3-1.
"They're looking for opportunities, really high-scoring chances, not just throwing it in the net," Penguins goaltender Sergei Murashov said of the Golden Knights. "Obviously, high-skill guys, but at the same time, it doesn't actually matter who you're facing as long as you're focusing on your game, it's going to work. It just challenges you to bring the best on the table from you. When you're able to do that, you can handle that."
The Mammoth hoped to build on their 4-2 victory over the Oilers on Thursday in Edmonton but couldn't match that energy in the second game of the home-and-home series Saturday.
"We knew it would be challenging, they will be ready on the other side," Utah coach Andre Tourigny said. "The kind of game it was in Edmonton, we knew it would be the same thing here (Saturday) night."
Tourigny was unhappy with Utah's performance in one-on-one puck battles and its inability to match Edmonton's physicality.
"It would be a challenge for the second game in a row, where we will have that level of physicality and compete," Tourigny said. "Kudos to Edmonton. They did it for two games in a row, and we didn't."
The loss snapped Utah's three-game winning streak and resembled a 6-1 defeat to the Boston Bruins that preceded the recent run.
"We can talk about learning, but we need to take those strides," Utah forward Lawson Crouse said. "It's a decision to go out there, play fast, play to our identity and win battles. I love the response. Not giving up, it seems like we never do, but we need that from the drop of the puck."
The Mammoth won't have to wait long for another matchup with Pittsburgh. The teams are scheduled to meet again Oct. 29 in Pittsburgh.
"It doesn't matter if you win or lose, they will come in the next game and they want to beat you, especially at home," Utah defenseman Mikhail Sergachev said. "(The loss to the Oilers) is going to be a lesson for us, just the small details."
--Field Level Media

By Maria Tsvetkova

NEW YORK, Oct 18 (Reuters) – The woman who was driving a pickup truck that entered a Kansas soccer field during a youth match, killing a man and 6-year-old boy, was released without charges while the investigation continues, authorities said on Sunday.

Investigators interviewed the 34-year-old woman, whom authorities have not publicly identified, and consulted with the Sedgwick County district attorney’s office before releasing her, the Wichita Police Department said in a statement.

Show Full Article

Police said toxicology testing and a mechanical examination of the vehicle were still under way.

The Chevrolet pickup truck had been parked near a soccer field in Wichita on Saturday before entering the pitch during a game and striking multiple people, police said.

Five children ages 5 to 9 and five adults suffered noncritical injuries, police said.

Two children of the driver were inside the truck when the incident occurred and were interviewed, police said. One of the driver’s children was playing on a different soccer field at the complex, according to the police statement.

Wichita police will present an initial review of the case to the district attorney early this week, district attorney’s office spokesperson Lyndsee Stover said in an email.

Police identified those killed in the crash as 6-year-old Cole Adrian and 35-year-old Nicholas Schafer of McPherson, Kansas.

“Our hearts are with the families of Adrian and Nicholas as they face an unimaginable loss. What should have been a day of children playing soccer and families spending time together ended in tragedy,” Wichita Police Chief Joe Sullivan said.

(Reporting by Maria Tsvetkova; Editing by Sergio Non and Cynthia Osterman)

items.title: Bills ride Josh Allen to 33-30 win over Raiders
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Josh Allen threw two touchdown passes, James Cook rushed for 95 yards and the go-ahead touchdown, and the Buffalo Bills beat the host Las Vegas Raiders 33-30 on Sunday.
items.body:
Josh Allen threw two touchdown passes, James Cook rushed for 95 yards and the go-ahead touchdown, and the Buffalo Bills beat the host Las Vegas Raiders 33-30 on Sunday.
Allen completed 23 of 33 passes for 255 yards, and Dalton Kincaid had seven receptions for 38 yards. Keon Coleman caught four passes for 59 yards and a touchdown for Buffalo (5-1).
For Las Vegas (3-3), Kirk Cousins completed 23 of 41 passes for 313 yards and two touchdowns to Tre Tucker, who caught five passes for 97 yards. Tight ends Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer combined for 11 receptions and 165 yards.
The Raiders didn't go down easily. Cousins launched a 44-yard touchdown pass to Tucker, who made a diving, headfirst grab in the end zone to trim the deficit to 33-30 with 92 seconds remaining before Buffalo recovered the ensuing onside kick attempt.
The same connection helped the Raiders tie the game at 23-all with 8:07 left. Tucker broke toward the sideline and away from Christian Benford for an 11-yard touchdown.
It took Allen only seven plays to go 66 yards and answer with Cook plowing in from 3 yards out for a 30-23 lead with 4:43 remaining.
Buffalo reclaimed possession after three consecutive Cousins incompletions. Allen hit Coleman for 15 yards to move the chains, and Cook picked up eight yards and then three more to force Las Vegas to use its second timeout with 2:36 to go.
Treydan Stukes stopped Cook for a 1-yard gain and wrapped up Khalil Shakir for a short gain before the two-minute warning, bringing on Tyler Bass. His 38-yard field goal, his fourth of the game, stretched the advantage to 33-23 with 1:56 left.
Las Vegas tried to chip away at Buffalo's lead early in the fourth quarter but settled for a field goal to cap a 15-play drive. The Raiders had first-and-goal at the 2-yard line but lost yardage and settled for three points to trail 23-16. They then forced the Bills to punt on the next possession.
Ashton Jeanty was stopped for a 3-yard loss by Greg Gaines. Cousins missed a wide-open Bowers and forced a pass to Cody White in tight coverage on third down, leading to Matt Gay's third field goal, a 23-yarder, to end the 15-play drive.
Allen found Coleman over the middle for a 12-yard touchdown to extend the Bills' lead to 10 points in the third quarter. The unorthodox shovel pass came after Allen escaped defenders and moved to the left of the line of scrimmage on a third-down play, making it 23-13 with 6:22 left in the third.
Jeanty, who entered the week hobbled by foot and ankle soreness, had a long gain of 8 yards and finished with 10 carries for 22 yards, including his first rushing touchdown of the season in the first quarter. He also caught four passes for 36 yards.
With 15 seconds left in the first half, the Bills' C.J. Gardner-Johnson was ejected for unsportsmanlike conduct. Replays appeared to show him hovering near the line of scrimmage and spitting toward Bowers' feet.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Chiefs remain unbeaten, control winless Chargers
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kenneth Walker III rushed for 128 yards and two touchdowns and Patrick Mahomes passed for 272 yards to boost the host Kansas City Chiefs to a 22-6 victory against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
items.body:
Kenneth Walker III rushed for 128 yards and two touchdowns and Patrick Mahomes passed for 272 yards to boost the host Kansas City Chiefs to a 22-6 victory against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
Kansas City improved to 5-0 to remain the lone unbeaten team in the AFC.
The skidding Chargers (0-6) are off to the franchise's worst start since the 2000 San Diego Chargers lost their first 11 games during a 1-15 season. Los Angeles coach Jim Harbaugh started five games at quarterback for that team.
Cameron Dicker kicked field goals of 23 and 30 yards for the Chargers. Los Angeles drove to the Kansas City 1-yard line on the first possession of the second half but settled for a Dicker kick after a holding penalty stalled the drive.
Kansas City's Harrison Butker was good from 30 yards with 3:52 to play for the Chiefs' only points of the second half.
Mahomes was 23-for-30 through the air while earning his 100th win as a starting quarterback.
The Chiefs sacked Chargers QB Justin Herbert four times, matching their season total entering the game. Los Angeles had two turnovers on downs.
Kansas City rolled to a 9-0 lead midway through the first quarter.
Los Angeles limited Kansas City to a 44-yard Butker field goal on the game's opening drive. The Chargers punted on their first possession, and the Chiefs responded with a six-play, 67-yard touchdown drive.
Walker scored on a 33-yard run up the middle with 7:21 to go in the quarter.
The Chargers answered with a 23-yard Dicker field goal after driving 60 yards in 11 plays. Herbert connected with Ladd McConkey for 17 yards on the first play of the drive, but McConkey was evaluated for a concussion after taking a hit near midfield.
McConkey was ruled out with a concussion late in the second quarter. He missed the previous game against the Denver Broncos with a foot injury.
The teams traded interceptions in the second quarter, with Jack Cochrane snagging a pick of Herbert before the Chargers' Cam Hart intercepted Mahomes. Kansas City forced a Los Angeles punt and seized control with Walker's 2-yard touchdown run with 1:49 to go before halftime.
Mahomes was 4-for-4 for 49 yards on the drive and added a run of 10 yards. Butker kicked a 50-yard field goal just before time expired on the second quarter as the Chiefs took a 19-3 advantage at halftime.
Herbert was 22-for-37 for 204 yards and an interception. He also led Los Angeles with 26 yards on five carries. Xavier Worthy had seven catches for 73 yards for the Chiefs.
Kansas City cornerback Christian Roland-Wallace was ejected early in the fourth quarter for throwing a punch against Chargers right tackle Alex Harkey.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ¿Hay una burbuja de IA en Wall Street? Las señales que inquietan al mercado
items.author: Emily Forgash, Geoffrey Morgan
items.summary: Las valoraciones, la concentración bursátil y el endeudamiento de las empresas tecnológicas alimentan las alertas, pero los múltiplos de ganancias y el sentimiento de los inversionistas no confirman t ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Desde titanes multimillonarios de fondos de cobertura como Ray Dalio y Michael Novogratz hasta innumerables analistas de mercado menos conocidos, cada vez más inversores profesionales están convencidos de que el mercado de valores está al borde de una burbuja debido al auge de la inteligencia artificial. Las referencias a la burbuja de las puntocom en los artículos periodísticos se disparan cada vez que el Nasdaq 100 alcanza nuevos máximos históricos, como ocurrió a principios de este mes. Toda esta incertidumbre podría explicar la caída del mercado la semana pasada, que provocó un descenso del 5,5% en el índice. Sin embargo, si esto realmente es una burbuja, a los inversores de Wall Street les está resultando más difícil definirla. Ver más: La deuda de CoreWeave se desploma y reaviva los temores sobre una burbuja de la IA Consideremos la simple relación precio-beneficio (P/E). En lugar de dispararse a niveles exagerados, como ocurrió durante la burbuja de las puntocom hace un cuarto de siglo, las relaciones P/E a futuro de índices de referencia como el S&P 500 y el Nasdaq 100 han disminuido este año debido a las expectativas de un crecimiento espectacular de las ganancias. De hecho, un mes antes de que el mercado alcanzara su máximo en el año 2000, las cinco mayores empresas tecnológicas del S&P 500 cotizaban a una relación P/E a futuro promedio de alrededor de 65, en comparación con aproximadamente 23 para las cinco mayores empresas tecnológicas en la actualidad. ¿Qué tiene este mercado que hace que tanta gente vea una burbuja? Y, si tienen razón, ¿qué hará falta para que estalle? Los expertos señalan diversos síntomas de sobrevaloración, desde niveles de deuda altísimos y expectativas de crecimiento de ganancias insostenibles hasta patrones de burbujas pasadas que se basan en sensaciones. “Si hubiera que destacar un elemento clave para una burbuja, podría ser este: la burbuja se convierte en una manía pública, una moda pasajera, y algunas personas se enriquecen de forma desmesurada, mientras que cualquiera que no participe se siente estúpido y se arrepiente”, dijo Howard Marks, copresidente de Oaktree Capital Management LP. Marks, quien predijo con gran perspicacia el punto álgido del mercado de las puntocom y advirtió el año pasado que estaba “vigilando una burbuja”, dijo que el término burbuja es “amorfo”, pero que generalmente requiere que los mercados alcancen niveles medibles que desafíen el juicio de los inversores, mientras que la asunción de riesgos y el sentimiento también se desconectan de la realidad. “Una burbuja es una exuberancia irracional, es una imprudencia”, dijo por teléfono. “La indiferencia es otra buena palabra”. Ver más: BofA ve riesgo de burbuja en tecnológicas y propone opciones para aprovechar el Nasdaq 100 Al analizar sus indicadores de burbuja preferidos en la actualidad, Marks no está convencido de que hayamos llegado a ese punto. Si bien los inversores muestran señales clásicas de temor a perderse un mayor repunte en el sector tecnológico, las constantes comparaciones con burbujas pasadas indican que no ignoran el riesgo. En cuanto a otra señal —la imprudencia de los inversores—, los indicios también son contradictorios. Los ratios tradicionales precio-beneficio no parecen propios de una burbuja en los niveles actuales, aunque resultan alarmantes cuando el múltiplo se basa en las ganancias de los últimos diez años. En el aspecto técnico, los operadores han señalado paralelismos con las caídas bursátiles que siguieron a burbujas anteriores. Han citado indicadores como el impulso extremo en un período de emisión récord de acciones y bonos. Otros datos preocupantes incluyen la amplia dispersión entre las acciones con mejor y peor desempeño dentro de un sector y la falta de amplitud en el mercado. Para Michael O’Rourke, estratega jefe de mercado de JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC, la disminución de los ratios precio/beneficio (P/E) entre las acciones de las grandes tecnológicas está justificada, dado el enorme endeudamiento que están adquiriendo para desarrollar la infraestructura de IA. Señala que los múltiplos se comprimen cuando las empresas se endeudan agresivamente, lo cual resulta especialmente preocupante dada la naturaleza circular de estas inversiones. Ver más: Nvidia demuestra que el repunte de las acciones de IA no es una burbuja, según DBS “Hemos llevado la financiación de proveedores a niveles totalmente nuevos”, donde los propios fabricantes de chips deben subvencionar la compra de sus productos, declaró O’Rourke en una entrevista. “De lo contrario, estas compras no se producirían”. Un indicador que preocupa a algunos inversores es el ratio precio-beneficio ajustado cíclicamente (CAPE, por sus siglas en inglés), que mide el precio de las acciones en relación con los beneficios ajustados a la inflación de los últimos 10 años. Este indicador se conoce a menudo como el ratio Shiller, en honor al economista de Yale Robert Shiller, quien publicó su libro " Exuberancia irracional" en marzo de 2000, justo cuando el mercado alcanzó su punto máximo. Nicholas Colas, cofundador de DataTrek Research, calificó la medida como “el gráfico de valoración más aterrador que circula actualmente”. En la actualidad, muestra un múltiplo de aproximadamente 41, ligeramente inferior al récord de 44 establecido en 1999. Otro motivo de preocupación es la extrema concentración en la cima del mercado bursátil. Hoy en día, Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ), Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) y Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ) —las tres mayores empresas estadounidenses por capitalización bursátil— representan aproximadamente el 21% del S&P 500, mientras que en octubre de 1999 se necesitaban casi 10 acciones para alcanzar ese nivel. No obstante, el rendimiento 250 puntos porcentuales superior del Nasdaq 100 en relación con el S&P 500 en los últimos 10 años es difícil de ignorar, incluso con todas las advertencias técnicas. “Aunque te preocupe un poco la tecnología, no puedes renunciar a ella. Casi parece una tontería hacerlo porque siempre ofrece mejores resultados”, dijo Jim Paulsen, un veterano del sector de las inversiones que ahora escribe un boletín informativo. Ver más: ¿Burbuja, boom o apocalipsis? Deutsche Bank recuerda las grandes predicciones que fallaron Un aspecto clave para muchos analistas de burbujas es el sentimiento de los inversores, que este año ha estado lejos de ser eufórico tanto a nivel institucional como minorista. La elevada inflación, la incertidumbre de las elecciones de mitad de mandato y la guerra con Irán han llevado a los operadores a adoptar una postura defensiva en varios momentos de 2026, mientras que el Nasdaq 100 experimentó múltiples retrocesos y una corrección del 10%. Aun así, hay indicios de que los inversores se sienten eufóricos ante las oportunidades de mercado que ofrece la revolución de la IA, incluyendo cambios de nombre corporativos que impulsan la rentabilidad de las acciones. Incluso el líder de una de las mayores beneficiarias de este auge ha criticado este optimismo desmedido. Ver más: ¿Hay una burbuja en la IA? BlackRock y Janus revelan oportunidades y segmentos “sobrevalorados” El CEO de Broadcom Inc. ( AVGO ), Hock Tan, afirmó que el auge de la IA ha atraído a inversores que “no tienen ni idea de en qué están invirtiendo” y se comportan como si estuvieran en un casino. Según se cuenta, otra señal de alerta frecuente sobre una burbuja inmobiliaria es cuando los encuentros fortuitos con trabajadores del sector servicios dan pie a conversaciones sobre inversiones. Se dice que Joseph Kennedy afirmó que supo que era el momento de vender cuando su limpiabotas empezó a darle consejos sobre acciones en 1929. Sam Stovall, estratega jefe de inversiones de CFRA, comentó que recientemente se produjo un encuentro similar: mientras hablaba con un hombre que atendía un quiosco de periódicos en Nueva York, le pidieron que imprimiera informes bursátiles sobre las empresas relacionadas con la IA, Intel Corp. ( INTC ) y Cisco Systems Inc. ( CSCO ). Independientemente de las señales de alerta que se tengan en cuenta, hablar de burbujas en Wall Street es cada vez más frecuente a medida que el actual mercado alcista entra en su quinto año. Durante la temporada de resultados del segundo trimestre, ejecutivos corporativos y analistas comentaron los paralelismos entre la crisis financiera mundial de 2008 y la burbuja tecnológica en 15 teleconferencias con inversores, entre ellas Goldman Sachs Group Inc. ( GS ), Analog Devices Inc. ( ADI ) y Blackstone Inc. ( BX ), según datos recopilados por Bloomberg Intelligence. Ver más: Goldman no cree que la IA sea una burbuja como la de las puntocom, pero advierte riesgos Mientras tanto, los tipos de interés se han disparado a niveles que pueden suponer un problema para las empresas que antes eran las favoritas del mercado. Las acciones de CoreWeave Inc. ( CRWV ) casi duplicaron su precio entre enero y principios de mayo, antes de que la caída de la semana pasada las hiciera bajar en lo que va de año, debido al aumento de los rendimientos de sus bonos. “Normalmente, es algún problema en el mercado crediticio lo que pone fin al ciclo”, afirmó Brian Reynolds, estratega jefe de mercado de Reynolds Strategy LLC. “Los verdaderos problemas surgen cuando las personas reciben requerimientos de margen que no pueden cubrir en el mercado crediticio”. Las burbujas también estallan cuando la creencia de que la tecnología puede cambiar el mundo se traduce en un entusiasmo desmedido en el mercado bursátil. Los inversores “se confían demasiado y luego pagan de más. Y eso es precisamente lo que significa pensar como una burbuja. No es que la IA no vaya a cambiar el mundo”, afirmó O’Rourke, de JonesTrading. Ver más: Un crítico de la IA advierte que OpenAI podría ser “el Lehman Brothers de la burbuja” del sector En ejemplos anteriores, como el auge de Internet, la tecnología tuvo un éxito rotundo y fue transformadora, y las ganancias bursátiles propiciaron un aumento masivo de la oferta de acciones mediante OPI y ofertas públicas de acciones. Sin embargo, cuando los resultados financieros decepcionaron y los tipos de interés subieron, las ganancias concentradas comenzaron a revertirse. Sin embargo, una señal reveladora que Marks no percibe actualmente en el mercado es la aparente indiferencia de los inversores ante los riesgos. De hecho, en Wall Street todo el mundo parece hablar de una posible burbuja. “Si un número suficiente de personas se pregunta con cautela si existe una burbuja en un área determinada, entonces tiene todo el sentido del mundo pensar que, si se trata de una burbuja, probablemente esté controlada”, dijo Marks. items.title: Los videojuegos por streaming amenazan a las consolas: mercado alcanzaría US$38.000 millones en 2035
items.author: Vlad Savov
items.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence prevé que los videojuegos por streaming alcancen un mercado de US$38.000 millones en 2035. La inteligencia artificial y la expansión de los centros de datos impulsarían el negoc ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Según un estudio de Bloomberg Intelligence, los juegos transmitidos por internet alcanzarán un mercado de US$38.000 millones en 2035 y podrían acabar con las consolas de videojuegos como producto de consumo masivo. Según un informe liderado por el analista de BI, Nathan Naidu, la proliferación de la inteligencia artificial y los centros de datos para la computación en la nube acelerará el alcance global de la transmisión de videojuegos y mejorará la rentabilidad. Ver más: ROG Xbox Ally X20: así es la consola de US$1.299 con la que ASUS y Xbox le hacen frente a la Steam Deck La IA desempeña un doble papel, ya que contribuye a la reducción de costos y facilita la infraestructura para los servicios de transmisión. A principios de la próxima década, la publicidad también se perfila como un motor clave de crecimiento que permitirá acceder a usuarios en los mercados emergentes. Según la investigación, este cambio relegará cada vez más a las consolas domésticas tradicionales a un segmento de mercado minoritario. A medida que la IA aumenta la complejidad de los juegos, la necesidad de un hardware cada vez más potente se cubriría de forma más eficaz mediante la transmisión de contenido desde centros de datos que diseñando y lanzando consolas completamente nuevas cada pocos años. Ver más: Google y Unity presentan Playground, una plataforma para crear videojuegos con IA sin programar La japonesa Nintendo Co., que hasta ahora solo había considerado la transmisión de juegos como algo secundario en su estrategia, parece estar mal posicionada para este cambio, mientras que su rival Sony Group Corp. parece estar mejor preparada gracias a su ecosistema PlayStation Plus, más consolidado, y a PlayStation Portal para el acceso remoto a los juegos. Por otra parte, Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ), Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ) y Tencent Holdings Ltd. se beneficiarán de sus inversiones en infraestructura en la nube, según Naidu. Se espera que Microsoft mantenga una cuota de mercado cercana al 40% con su servicio Xbox Cloud Gaming, que registró aproximadamente 220 millones de horas de juego en streaming durante el trimestre de septiembre. Nvidia, como diseñador de las unidades de procesamiento gráfico (GPU) más codiciadas, cuenta con una ventaja tecnológica gracias a GeForce Now, y Tencent, de manera similar, es considerada un líder tecnológico en el ecosistema chino. Las GPU son el hardware más eficaz tanto para cargas de trabajo de IA como de gráficos 3D. Ver más: Cómo Pokémon y Resident Evil reescribieron la historia de los videojuegos “Actualmente, la creciente demanda de servicios de centros de datos de IA está ejerciendo presión al alza sobre los precios de la computación. Sin embargo, creemos que en los últimos años de esta década, la expansión de los centros de datos generará un excedente de capacidad de GPU”, afirmó Naidu en el informe. “Un mayor exceso de capacidad aumentaría la competencia y reduciría los precios de la computación, mejorando la rentabilidad para los operadores de juegos en la nube”. Los videojuegos son una de las industrias más expuestas a la IA. La tecnología utilizada para crearlos comparte sus fundamentos con las herramientas de IA, y la necesidad generalizada de reducir costes ha presionado a todas las empresas para que disminuyan su plantilla y se centren en la eficiencia. El CEO de Epic Games Inc., Tim Sweeney, declaró esta semana que su empresa está reorganizando a sus desarrolladores para optimizar su uso y lograr la máxima aceleración de la IA. Su empresa proporciona el Unreal Engine, ampliamente utilizado para crear juegos en 3D. Ver más: Más de 900 millones de copias: las ventas de Super Mario, la franquicia de videojuegos más vendida “El hardware para videojuegos se está orientando hacia un mercado más reducido de aficionados. Las consolas seguirán siendo relevantes para los jugadores apasionados que buscan un rendimiento superior, y quizás también para los coleccionistas, del mismo modo que los tocadiscos se siguen utilizando para escuchar música”, escribió Naidu. “Pero el papel de las consolas está pasando de ser la principal puerta de entrada a los videojuegos a ser solo uno de los muchos puntos de acceso, y uno relativamente poco rentable, por cierto”. items.title: Australia's Cleanaway agrees to $6.5 billion EQT takeover, shares surge
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cleanaway Waste Management said on Monday it had agreed to be bought by Swedish private equity group EQT in a deal valuing the Australian waste management company at about A$9.3 billion ($6.5 billion), including debt.
items.body:
Cleanaway Waste Management (CWY.AX) said on Monday it had agreed to be bought by Swedish private equity group EQT (EQTAB.ST) in a deal valuing the Australian waste management company at about A$9.3 billion ($6.5 billion), including debt.
Here are some more details:
Shares of Cleanaway rose nearly 20% to A$2.960, set for their best day since October, 2011
Under the terms of the deal, Cleanaway shareholders will receive A$3.095 in cash for each share held, less the cash amount of any dividends paid before completion of the transaction
The consideration reflects EQT's indicative offer of A$3.13 per share, adjusted for Cleanaway's final dividend paid on October 8
Cleanaway said the A$3.13 offer values the company at about A$9.3 billion, including debt, and represents a 32.1% premium to its closing share price on August 12, the last trading day before EQT's approach was disclosed
Cleanaway said its board unanimously recommends shareholders vote in favour of the scheme implementation deed, in the absence of a superior proposal
The firm said it may pay aggregate cash dividends of up to A$0.19 per share before implementation, including a fully franked special dividend. Any dividends paid will be deducted from the scheme consideration
[USN:L4N4491P9 TEXT:"In August"], the Melbourne-based waste solutions provider had granted exclusive due diligence to EQT Infrastructure, managed by Swedish investment firm EQT

items.title: Driver released after pickup truck kills 2, injures 10 at Kansas youth soccer game
items.author: Maria Tsvetkova
items.creator: Maria Tsvetkova
items.summary: The woman who was driving a pickup truck that entered a Kansas soccer field during a youth match, killing a man and 6-year-old boy, was released without charges while the investigation continues, authorities said on Sunday.
items.body:
The woman who was driving a pickup truck that entered a Kansas soccer field during a youth match, [USN:SPN45Y0Z2 TEXT:"killing a man and 6-year-old"] boy, was released without charges while the investigation continues, authorities said on Sunday.
Investigators interviewed the 34-year-old woman, whom authorities have not publicly identified, and consulted with the Sedgwick County district attorney's office before releasing her, the Wichita Police Department said in a statement.
Police said toxicology testing and a mechanical examination of the vehicle were still under way.
The Chevrolet pickup truck had been parked near a soccer field in Wichita on Saturday before entering the pitch during a game and striking multiple people, police said.
Five children ages 5 to 9 and five adults suffered noncritical injuries, police said.
Two children of the driver were inside the truck when the incident occurred and were interviewed, police said. One of the driver's children was playing on a different soccer field at the complex, according to the police statement.
Wichita police will present an initial review of the case to the district attorney early this week, district attorney's office spokesperson Lyndsee Stover said in an email.
Police identified those killed in the crash as 6-year-old Cole Adrian and 35-year-old Nicholas Schafer of McPherson, Kansas.
"Our hearts are with the families of Adrian and Nicholas as they face an unimaginable loss. What should have been a day of children playing soccer and families spending time together ended in tragedy," Wichita Police Chief Joe Sullivan said.

items.title: ＡＩ能力向上で米ＧＤＰは2030年に50%増も＝アンソロピック幹部
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Lawder

[バンコク １７日 ロイター] - 米生成人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの共同創業者...
items.body:
ＡＩ能力向上で米ＧＤＰは2030年に50%増も＝アンソロピック幹部
8:39 配信

アンソロピック共同創設者のジャック・クラーク氏。10月16日、タイのバンコクで撮影。 REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

David Lawder

[バンコク １７日 ロイター] - 米生成人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの共同創業者で公共政策部門トップを務めるジャック・クラーク氏は１７日、タイの首都バンコクで開かれた国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会の関連会合で講演し、ＡＩの能力向上により、あらゆる分野で変化のスピードが大幅に加速するとの認識を示した。

クラーク氏は同社の社内モデルによる試算として、一定の条件下で米国の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）が２０３０年までに現在の３０兆ドル超から約４４兆ドルへほぼ５０％増加する可能性があると説明した。またＡＩが科学的発見を大幅に加速させていると指摘した。試算はＡＩ技術が今後も進歩し続けることを前提としており、大幅な経済成長が実現する場合には、その成長を支える新産業や新たな発明が生まれる必要があるとの見方を示した。

一方でＡＩがもたらす変革に対応するため、各国による国際協調の下で「異例かつ厳格なルール」を整備する必要があると強調し、政策当局が対応できる時間は限られていると警鐘を鳴らした。クラーク氏はＡＩ開発の速度が人間の管理能力を上回る「シンギュラリティー（技術的特異点）」の兆候が強まっていると述べた上で「今後数年間でＡＩだけでなく科学全体の進歩のペースが加速するだろう。それは混乱や戸惑いを生む一方で、大きな富と重大なリスクをもたらす可能性がある」と付け加えた。

ＩＭＦ・世界銀行会合では、ＡＩが高エネルギー価格の影響を補う成長要因になるとの期待が示された半面、生産性向上効果が期待外れに終わった場合や関連銘柄の株価が急落した場合の金融安定への影響を懸念する声も上がった。雇用の喪失や、一部の国がＡＩ革命から取り残されることへの不安も示された。

これに対してクラーク氏は、ＡＩが数学、工学、生物学などの研究を支援し、新薬開発を含む科学的発見を加速させると予想するとともに、研究者が数百から数千のＡＩアシスタントに支援されることで、科学研究の生産性が高まると述べた。

さらにＡＩの稼働に必要なデータセンター整備に各国が関与することで、より多くの国がＡＩ革命に参加できるとの考えも明らかにした。

ただＡＩの高度化は生物兵器やサイバー兵器など科学技術の悪用につながる恐れもあると警告し、「ＡＩを科学に活用できることは、科学の悪用にも道を開く。私たちは多くの選択を迫られている」とくぎを刺した。

特に生物学研究についてはＡＩが既に新たなウイルスを生み出している点に触れて「最も厳格な人的監督と透明性を確保する必要がある」と強調した。

最近ＡＩが試験環境を抜け出したり、ウェブサイトやデータベースに侵入したりする事例も報告されている問題についてクラーク氏は「現時点ではなお人間が管理している」と語りながらも、安全対策を導入するための猶予は「あと数年程度」に縮小しているとの認識を示した。

［バンコク　１７日　ロイター］ - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁は１７日、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）が「主要先進国」の財政リスクとその波及効果に対する監視を強めることを、中国は支持すると表明した。国際通貨金融委員会（ＩＭＦＣ）会合で述べた。

人民銀の声明によると、潘氏はＩＭＦに対し、世界的な不均衡を分析するとともに、資本フローなどの金融要因が不均衡に与える影響をより重視するよう求めた。その上で、中国は多国間貿易体制を支持し、あらゆる形の保護主義的措置に反対すると述べた。

ＩＭＦのゲオルギエワ専務理事は１４日、中国は輸出主導型の成長から、より内需主導型の成長へと転換しなければならないと述べた。

items.title: Ampol shares slump as maintenance work overshadows strong refining margins
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia's Ampol on Monday cut its fourth-quarter output forecast for higher-value products at its Lytton refinery after bringing forward maintenance work, overshadowing a surge in third-quarter refining margins and sending its shares lower.
items.body:
Australia's Ampol (ALD.AX) on Monday cut its fourth-quarter output forecast for higher-value products at its Lytton refinery after bringing forward maintenance work, overshadowing a surge in third-quarter refining margins and sending its shares lower.
The country's top fuel retailer said an inspection of Lytton's Fluidised Catalytic Cracking Unit (FCCU) identified the need for additional maintenance work, delaying the unit's restart to mid-November.
The maintenance work is expected to cut fourth-quarter output of gasoline, diesel and jet fuel by 150 million litres from the previous forecast.
Shares of the company fell as much as 7% to A$40.00, marking their lowest level since August 24. The stock was among the top losers on the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index (.AXJO) , which was up 0.3%.
Total group sales volume was 6,245 million litres in the third quarter, up from 6,028 million litres a year earlier.
Refining performance continued to benefit from elevated regional margins, partly offset by higher landed crude premiums and planned maintenance, Ampol said.
Double-digit growth in the international segment helped offset weaker sales in Australia and New Zealand.
Ampol said its Lytton refining margin more than doubled to $23.92 per barrel in the third quarter from $10.64 a year earlier, supported by supply disruptions linked to the Middle East conflict.
The company said the disruptions remained a net positive for its integrated supply chain.
The convenience retail segment, excluding EG Australia and U-GO sites, reported higher headline shop sales than a year earlier.
Ampol said third-quarter group replacement cost operating profit EBIT rose from the average quarterly level in the second half of the previous year, reflecting the strength of its integrated supply chain and favourable operating conditions.

items.title: Tyler Reddick uses bold move to win Freeway Insurance 500
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tyler Reddick had to take his No. 45 Toyota to the Arizona desert to end his thirst for victory.
items.body:
Tyler Reddick had to take his No. 45 Toyota to the Arizona desert to end his thirst for victory.
The 23XI Racing driver made a two-tire stop on the final pit stop, completed a bold four-wide move on a restart and returned to Victory Lane by winning Sunday afternoon's Freeway Insurance 500 at Phoenix Raceway in Avondale, Ariz.
In earning his NASCAR Cup Series-leading sixth win, Reddick passed Chase Briscoe with 18 laps to go and pulled away to beat polesitter Ryan Blaney by 0.801 seconds. It was Reddick's first win at the 1-mile track and the 14th of his career.
"We wanted to be a lot better when we came back here, and I think we checked that box," said Reddick, who led 18 laps and last won April 19 at Kansas. "This group never lost its motivation or its drive. We kept searching and trying to find ways to make ourselves and all-around better team. ... I had a really good feeling today.
"I didn't have a good launch (on the final restart), but there was a hole, and I was able to get through it."
Blaney, Chase Elliott, Christopher Bell and Corey Heim rounded out the top five.
Points leader Kyle Larson had an accident late and finished 34th, while Denny Hamlin had a flat tire and a penalty and placed 28th.
"Not a good one," Larson said of his showing in the six-caution race. "I was just trying to salvage anything. A top-20 would've been great. I just blew a right front. A lot of people were."
Larson leads Bell by six points, with Briscoe 24 points back, Hamlin 31 back and Blaney 40 back to round out the top five in the standings.
Running near the back of the top 20 on the flat oval, Riley Herbst and Michael McDowell wrecked to bring out the first caution. The ensuing pit stops ended with Hamlin taking two tires and leading Hendrick Motorsports drivers William Byron and Elliott off pit road.
Joey Logano easily won the stage, while Hamlin, Bell, Blaney and Briscoe collected the descending bonus points. After taking two tires and restarting fifth, Larson's No. 5 Chevrolet crossed the line in 22nd.
Hamlin gradually worked his way forward to just outside the top 10, while two-time Cup Series champion Larson continued to slide during Stage 2's 125 laps. Larson lost a lap and ran 28th as the race neared the midpoint.
Logano won the race off pit road after Austin Dillon's wreck and maintained a solid lead over Briscoe en route to a 1-2 finish in Stage 2. Bell, Josh Berry and Bubba Wallace followed in stage points, while Larson ran 27th but managed to remain on the lead lap.
Logano, a three-time series champion, led as the final stretch began but soon complained of a vibration as Wallace cut into his advantage.
Running fourth, Hamlin's No. 11 Toyota cut a right rear tire on Lap 221, forcing him to pit under green. He was then caught speeding. Cody Ware immediately wrecked after a tire problem, putting Hamlin a lap down.
Wallace was first off pit road and led by 1.3 seconds when he pitted with 43 laps remaining, handing the lead to Briscoe.
Larson suffered a flat tire and hit the wall with about 30 laps remaining, bringing out the final caution, while Wallace was penalized for speeding.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Chad Ryland's sixth FG is a winner as Cardinals edge Rams
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Arizona Cardinals received a career-best six field goals from Chad Ryland, including the game winner from 43 yards as time expired, to earn an 18-16 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday at Inglewood, Calif.
items.body:
The Arizona Cardinals received a career-best six field goals from Chad Ryland, including the game winner from 43 yards as time expired, to earn an 18-16 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday at Inglewood, Calif.
Jacoby Brissett completed 24 of 35 passes for 218 yards with an interception, while leading the Cardinals on a game-winning 40-yard scoring drive in the closing minute.
Bam Knight rushed for 80 yards on 15 carries for Arizona (2-4), which had 338 yards of total offense to 286 for the Rams. The Cardinals won for the second time this season in the Los Angeles area after a Week 1 road victory over the Chargers.
Matthew Stafford completed 25 of 33 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns but struggled to get the Rams offense going against a blitzing Cardinals defense. Puka Nacua had six receptions for 80 yards for Los Angeles (2-4).
While Ryland was the star for the Cardinals, the Rams lost new kicker Blake Grupe in the first quarter when he injured his knee on a kickoff and did not return.
The Rams got on the scoreboard first with a 44-yard field goal from Grupe with 9:41 left in the first quarter. Grupe was signed after Harrison Mevis was released after missing two field goals in an overtime loss Monday to the Buffalo Bills.
On the ensuing kickoff, Grupe was injured making a tackle on Devin Duvernay and did not return.
The Cardinals pushed in front 6-3 on consecutive field goals from Ryland, including the second from 30 yards early in the second quarter.
The Rams went on a 12-play, 73-yard drive in the second quarter that ended on a 15-yard TD pass from Stafford to Blake Corum. But Stafford was sacked on a two-point conversion attempt as the Rams were left with a 9-6 lead.
Arizona tied the score 9-9 on a 22-yard field goal from Ryland late in the first half and went up 12-9 on a 38-yarder midway through the third quarter. Ryland made it 15-9 with 9:28 remaining after a 27-yard field goal.
The Rams went ahead 16-15 with 47 seconds remaining on a 6-yard TD reception from Colby Parkinson. Punter Ethan Evans made the extra point.
The key to the Cardinals' game-winning drive was a 21-yard pass to Jalen Brooks and a 15-yard personal foul penalty on the Rams at the end of the play.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Zelenskiy acusa a Trump de presionar a Ucrania para que se rinda ante Rusia
items.author: Daryna Krasnolutska, Volodymyr Verbianyi, Olesia Safronova
items.summary: El presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, acusó a Donald Trump de intentar presionar a Kiev para que se rindiera ante Rusia, lo que agravó la disputa que ya llevaba una semana con el presidente de ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, acusó a Donald Trump de intentar presionar a Kiev para que se rindiera a Rusia, intensificando así una disputa que ya duraba una semana con el presidente estadounidense. Zelenskiy también ofreció una nueva propuesta para acceder a la petición de Trump de dejar de atacar las refinerías rusas, cuyo objetivo era combatir los altos precios del diésel, a cambio de la entrega de más misiles de defensa aérea Patriot. Ver más: Zelenskiy desafía a Trump y ordena nuevos ataques contra refinerías rusas “Ahora nos esperan días peligrosos antes de las elecciones”, dijo Zelenskiy, refiriéndose a las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre en Estados Unidos. “Mi último modelo era: no atacamos el diésel ruso, ustedes nos dan misiles para los sistemas Patriot para proteger nuestras instalaciones. Pero ellos solo quieren que dejemos de atacar el diésel. Y si atacamos eso, nos desconectarán de algo”. En un momento en que las relaciones entre Estados Unidos y Ucrania han alcanzado un nuevo mínimo, Zelenskiy expuso lo que, según él, eran una serie de acciones hostiles de Washington hacia Kiev. Estas incluyen la ralentización deliberada de la velocidad de internet de Starlink, crucial para las tropas ucranianas que luchan contra Rusia, y el retraso en la entrega de los ya escasos interceptores Patriot para misiles balísticos, que se han convertido en una pesadilla para las ciudades ucranianas, dijo el domingo en una entrevista con Bloomberg. Ver más: Zelenskiy se reúne con enviados de Trump en Kiev para buscar un acuerdo de paz con Rusia “Creo que se han tomado medidas para convencer a Ucrania de que capitule”, dijo Zelenskiy desde su despacho en Kiev. “No estoy diciendo que ese sea el objetivo de nuestros socios. No quiero pensar que nuestros socios estadounidenses crean que la guerra contra Rusia podría terminar antes a costa de Ucrania. Pero así lo parece”. Las tensiones entre Ucrania y Estados Unidos alcanzaron su punto más bajo después de que Trump llegara a un acuerdo con Vladimir Putin, según el cual Washington se abstendría de endurecer aún más las sanciones contra Rusia a cambio de que Moscú suministrara volúmenes limitados de diésel al mercado mundial para frenar el aumento de los precios. Trump provocó la indignación de miembros de su propio partido cuando anunció el viernes por la noche que eximiría a Ucrania de parte de la nueva ley de sanciones contra Rusia, que lleva el nombre del fallecido senador Lindsey Graham. Zelenskiy añadió que las relaciones con Estados Unidos podrían mejorar después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato en ese país. Ver más: Zelenskiy propone conversaciones de paz a Putin y ofrece un alto al fuego “La política es muy agresiva durante la época electoral”, dijo. “Creo que ahora mismo se vive una situación angustiosa, pero después de las elecciones la vida continuará y creo que habrá más tranquilidad”. Estados Unidos ha exigido a Kiev que detenga los ataques contra las refinerías de petróleo rusas. La administración Trump ha argumentado que estos ataques han contribuido al aumento de los precios de la energía, especialmente del diésel, a pesar de que la guerra de Estados Unidos con Irán ha afectado mucho más al suministro mundial. Ucrania ha declarado estar dispuesta a detener los ataques contra las refinerías si Rusia se abstiene de atacar su infraestructura energética. Sin embargo, ambas partes han continuado atacando instalaciones energéticas . Ucrania reanudó sus ataques tras una pausa de varios días para ver si Rusia respetaría el “alto el fuego energético” anunciado por Trump. Ucrania afirmó que las fuerzas rusas atacaron subestaciones eléctricas durante el fin de semana, dejando a decenas de miles de familias sin electricidad, mientras que Rusia combatía incendios en la terminal petrolera de San Petersburgo y otras instalaciones industriales. Ver más: Zelenskiy define los próximos pasos mientras Kiev y Moscú intercambian ataques Zelenskiy hizo estas declaraciones después de que Ucrania se quejara de que SpaceX, la empresa estadounidense propiedad de Elon Musk, había ralentizado la velocidad de internet de Starlink en Ucrania. El servicio de internet por satélite es crucial para las tropas ucranianas y ha sido una de las principales ventajas del país en el campo de batalla durante su guerra contra Rusia, que ya lleva cinco años. Al preguntársele quién ordenó la medida, Zelenskiy señaló a “las autoridades, la Casa Blanca”, citando “fuentes” que no identificó. Afirma que la velocidad de internet de Starlink se interrumpe a velocidades superiores a 161 kilómetros por hora en Ucrania, mientras que fuera del país funciona sin limitaciones. Los drones rusos viajan a unos 400 kilómetros por hora. Zelenskiy también afirmó que Estados Unidos está retrasando la entrega de interceptores para los sistemas de defensa aérea Patriot, utilizados para derribar los misiles balísticos rusos, que causan los mayores daños a la infraestructura de las ciudades ucranianas. “Hemos pagado por las armas”, incluidos los misiles antibalísticos del programa PURL, declaró Zelenskiy. “Una parte de los suministros ha sido autorizada” por Estados Unidos, “mientras que el resto no. Y esto no es un problema técnico”. Ver más: Autoridades ucranianas investigan por lavado de dinero a un antiguo aliado de Zelenskiy Según Zelenskiy, Estados Unidos actualmente suministra a Ucrania solo 12 misiles interceptores Patriot al mes, aproximadamente una cuarta parte del ritmo que se alcanzaba bajo la administración de Joe Biden. Durante el mandato de Trump, Estados Unidos vendía esos misiles a Ucrania, mientras que Biden los proporcionaba gratuitamente como ayuda militar. “Creo que el presidente de Estados Unidos tiene una buena relación con Putin”, dijo Zelenskiy. “Pero hay algo que no funciona. Actualmente, Trump no puede obligar a Putin a poner fin a la guerra”. Mientras tanto, Zelenskiy mantiene un contacto estrecho con los principales enviados de Trump para las conversaciones de paz con Ucrania, Jared Kushner y Steve Witkoff, y declaró el domingo que están discutiendo otra reunión, probablemente a finales de esta semana. El trío ya se había reunido en Kiev a principios de septiembre. En aquella ocasión, Kushner y Witkoff viajaron primero a Moscú para conversar con Putin antes de su primera visita a Ucrania para negociar con Zelenskiy. Ver más: Trump califica de buena su reunión con Zelenskiy y afirma que la guerra debe terminar El enfrentamiento con Estados Unidos llega en el peor momento posible para Ucrania, justo cuando el país se prepara para un invierno excepcionalmente difícil. El uso de drones propulsados por reactores por parte de Rusia, sumado a una grave escasez de interceptores, ha dejado a Ucrania cada vez más vulnerable a los ataques aéreos masivos, minando la moral pública. El país ya sufre apagones que duran horas, mientras que sus ciudades más grandes se preparan para interrupciones aún mayores, incluyendo posibles cortes de calefacción, agua potable y alcantarillado. Al preguntársele cómo describiría los esfuerzos para recomponer las relaciones con Estados Unidos, Zelenskiy respondió: “Creo que cuando los riesgos potenciales para Ucrania son de proporciones catastróficas, se debe intervenir cuando aún es una tormenta leve. Creo que hay mucho más en juego que el acuerdo sobre el diésel”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com
